clock_rows_qualification: created_at is a wall-clock storage timestamp and is NOT the logical provider billing clock. server_consent_window_ms and race_launch_elapsed_since_server_creation_ms apply to real-time rows only; simulated-clock timing is established by the recorded frozen provider time/advances and stored deadline, not wall-clock created_at.
race_scope: Actual provider pay and authenticated expiry minute-job launched concurrently; payment won before any provider void intent. Four durable intents observed (invoice_create,item_create,finalize,pay), no provider void request. Result proves late-payment/expiry-worker convergence to attention, not simultaneous successful payment and void.
wait_measurement: Raw race.actual_wait_ms starts after the confirm HTTP/provider round trip; it is shorter than the full original server consent interval. No original timestamp or deadline edited.
